name: Device
description: Device information: battery, time, Bluetooth, WiFi, brightness, volume
prompt_section:
### Device Tools
- getBatteryLevel() — battery percentage
- getCurrentTime() — current date/time
- getBluetoothState() — Bluetooth on/off
- getNetworkInfo() — WiFi/network status
- getDeviceInfo() — device model, OS
- getVolume() / setVolume(level) — media volume
- setBrightness(level) — screen brightness (0-255)
- toggleFlashlight() — flashlight on/off
- pingHost(host) — ping network host
